instructorNote: This page starts the 2 percent special-report clock. Watch for three things: the CMO signs the 05:10 entry, then phones the VSP and sends the written report by 06:10 with the Master's countersignature, and the PH director checks it against the signed log and confirms receipt. Push for the Houston quarantine station notice and copies to the Galveston County Health District and Texas DSHS. Also watch that nobody uses the unofficial 2,978 passenger figure.
